verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Khoj supports first-party custom agents with personas and tools, and official clients such as Obsidian and Emacs. Nothing in the pack shows a community marketplace or library of published skills, plugins, or presets, let alone thousands with active maintainers. A community user asking for an extensible data-connector interface further suggests no third-party plugin ecosystem exists.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers
